01 · Motivation

Understand technology.
Shape innovation.

I am looking for a new professional perspective where I can combine my engineering experience with artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, and actively contribute to developing new solutions.

What drives me

I am motivated by understanding how technology works, not just by using it. AI particularly interests me because it opens up new ways of solving complex problems. Continuous learning, hands-on experimentation and exchanging ideas go hand in hand for me.

My career goal

I want to develop into an AI engineer with a security focus: building intelligent systems, addressing risks early and applying AI where it creates tangible technical value.

My ideal work environment

I am looking for an innovation-oriented environment that embraces AI, enables meaningful contributions and supports professional development. Open exchange, responsibility and fair, performance-based compensation are important to me.

What I want to contribute

I want to combine my experience in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, industrial software and product security with my computer science studies. I bring a practical engineering mindset and the willingness to explore new technical domains.
